svg.title: What the assistant does with a problem of its settings
svg.desc: Every command reads labels.toml, config.toml and config.project.toml. A file that isn't TOML stops every command, with the line of the mistake. A value of another type than its key's stops every other command with an error that names the key; check reads the rest with the defaults and names every problem at once. A key that the assistant doesn't know changes nothing, so check fails on it and names the key that was probably meant, while the other commands warn of it and keep the default.
